Key Findings

  • Engineering file server shared with production network.
  • OEM customer drawings stored without access restrictions.
  • No offline backups.

Data Obtained

  • CAD drawings and engineering specifications
  • OEM supply contracts and quality agreements
  • Production and quality data (SAP exports)
  • HR and payroll
  • Finance and controlling
